scope: Focused macOS PostgreSQL performance-error follow-up; no replay of the complete correctness/fault suite

parameters.transport: Private Python fault proxy with connection capacity 8. Proxy and Python HTTP clients share the same Python process. Measurements include that fixture cost.

conclusion.confirmed: Two same-parameter focused attempts on the newer frozen CLI completed without errors and cleaned all four PostgreSQL connections after normal drain.
conclusion.unresolved: The earlier 49 JSONDecodeError instances lack response bodies. They cannot be retroactively classified as acquire_timeout, malformed JSON, or another error. A later pass is not proof of their cause or repair.
conclusion.production_changes: None. No reproduced pool or PostgreSQL error justified changing the production implementation.
conclusion.driver_changes: Classify literal error:<code> responses explicitly; retain at most 12 bounded error examples including response body; record the 100ms acquire budget and actual proxy/client topology.
conclusion.pool_review: Existing registered-waiter admission and timeout handoff code are present. Condition-variable wake order is not a strict FIFO promise. No new starvation condition was reproduced.
not_claimed: root cause of the old 49 errors
